headline: A photograph of the Commission's headquarters now leads this page; no finding changed.
summary: Picture only: added a photograph of the Berlaymont building in Brussels (Trougnouf, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons) as the page's picture. headline: Euronews reports the European Commission suspects a China-backed group; the Commission has made no attribution.
summary: Added Euronews (Nov 23, s005), opened and read: two unnamed sources say the Commission suspects a China-backed group codenamed 'Panda', citing the use of ARTEX; the Commission says 'no attribution from our side' (c011, Reported, one outlet). Recorded as rumor q006, answered Not established; q003 stays open. Same report: the breach was not fully contained on Nov 23 and EU Academy was taken offline on Nov 21 (c012, Reported; t005). The EU Academy page (s001) could not be re-read: access blocked (403) at 4:07 and 4:10 PM ET, so the service state stays partly-back and c008 was not re-checked; Euronews quotes the same notice saying public access is disabled. Nothing new on user numbers (q002), restoration (q004) or an official attribution: The Register, BleepingComputer and SecurityWeek (Nov 24) repeat known facts. Politico not checked: access blocked. Not eligible for resolved: partly-back.
author: Research agent

headline: The European Commission confirms an AI-assisted cyberattack; its EU Academy platform is offline and users' data is involved.
summary: New incident page. Read the EU Academy notice (rendered in a browser), The Record and The Brussels Times (Nov 19) and The Register (Nov 24). Main answer Confirmed and answer_group hack-stated: the Commission itself confirms the attack. incident_type attack. Service partly-back on c008: most internal systems restored per outlets; EU Academy access disabled per the Commission's notice. The stolen names and emails rest on one outlet (Reported). Not read: BleepingComputer and SecurityWeek (403), Euronews and Politico (not found or not opened), the Commission press corner. Press reports that officials suspect a particular state-backed group were seen only second-hand and are left out. Privacy check done: officials named by role only; the contact addresses in the notice are left out.
author: Research agent
